camel_example: aliyun cas CreateCsr --region cn-hangzhou --Locality Beijing --CountryCode CN --KeySize 2048 --Algorithm RSA --Province Beijing --CommonName 'example.com'
description_en: Creates a certificate signing request (CSR) that contains information about an SSL certificate to apply for, such as the domain names and the certificate holder. You must provide a CSR when you submit a certificate application to a certificate authority (CA)
description_zh: CSR是证书请求文件，包含您的SSL证书信息，例如，证书绑定的域名、证书持有主体的名称及地理位置信息等。您向CA中心提交证书申请时，必须提供CSR。CA中心审核通过您的证书申请后，将使用其根CA私钥为您提供的CSR签名，生成SSL证书公钥（即签发给您的SSL证书）。SSL证书的私钥即您在生成CSR时同时生成的私钥
kebab_example: aliyun cas create-csr --key-size 2048 --algorithm RSA --common-name example.com --country-code CN --province Beijing --locality Beijing --api-version 2020-04-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateCsr

parameters.help_en:
The key length that is used by the algorithm.

The key length for RSA algorithms can be 2,048, 3,072, and 4,096 bits.

The key length for ECC and SM2 algorithms can be 256 bits
parameters.help_zh:
密钥算法长度。
RSA算法长度一般为2048、3072、4096等。
ECC和SM2算法长度一般为256
parameters.name: key_size

parameters.help_en: The algorithm. Valid values: RSA, SM2, and ECC. For more information about algorithms, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/197871.html
parameters.help_zh: CSR密钥算法，仅支持RSA、SM2、ECC。更多关于密钥算法的说明，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/197871.html
parameters.name: algorithm

parameters.help_en: The primary domain name, which is a common name
parameters.name: common_name

parameters.help_en: The secondary domain names. Separate multiple domain names with commas (,). You can use the CSR to apply for a certificate for both the primary and secondary domain names
parameters.help_zh: 备用名称，申请同一SSL证书的其他域名，多个域名请使用英文逗号分隔
parameters.name: sans

parameters.help_en: The code of the country or region in which the organization is located. For example, you can use CN to indicate China and use US to indicate the United States
parameters.help_zh: 设置证书组织机构所在国家或地区的代码。例如，CN 表示中国，US 表示美国
parameters.name: country_code

parameters.help_en: The province or location where the company is located
parameters.help_zh: 公司所在省份或者地区
parameters.name: province

parameters.help_en: The city where the company is located
parameters.name: locality

parameters.help_en: The name of the CSR. The name can be up to 50 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, underscores (_), hyphens (-), and periods (.)
parameters.help_zh: CSR名称。长度不超过50个字符，且仅支持英文大小写字母（a~z和A~Z）、阿拉伯数字（0~9）、下划线（_）、短划线（-）和半角句号（.）
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The department that uses the certificate
parameters.name: department

CsrId.description_en: The unique identifier of the CSR. You can use this value to obtain the content of the CSR. For more information about the operation that you can call to obtain the content of a CSR, see [GetCsrDetail]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2709720.html）
CsrId.description_zh: CSR唯一标识。后续可通过该值直接获取CSR内容。获取CSR的接口请参见[GetCsrDetail]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2709720.html）

RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
